definitions.explanation: Used to refer to each thing or person in a group separately.

examples.japanese: それぞれの{国|くに}に{文化|ぶんか}がある。
examples.english: Each country has its own culture.

examples.japanese: {学生|がくせい}たちはそれぞれ{違|ちが}う{意見|いけん}を{持|も}っている。
examples.english: The students each have different opinions.

examples.japanese: それぞれの{部屋|へや}がある。
examples.english: Each person has their own room.

examples.japanese: それぞれ{好|す}きなものを{選|えら}んでください。
examples.english: Please choose what you like individually.

examples.japanese: {三人|さんにん}はそれぞれ{違|ちが}う{道|みち}に{進|すす}んだ。
examples.english: The three each went their separate ways.

notes: Can function as noun or adverb. Often followed by の when modifying nouns.
